title: Cache
description: How much of the input is served from the prompt cache, and what it saves.

panels.title: Cache hit share of input

targets.queryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, 100.0 * sum(cache_read_input_tokens) / max(sum(input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens), 1) as "cache read share" from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, 100.0 * sum(cache_read_input_tokens) / max(sum(input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens), 1) as "cache read share" from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: cache_read / (fresh input + cache writes + cache read), per hour.

panels.title: Input tokens by kind, per hour

targets.queryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, sum(cache_read_input_tokens) as "cache read", sum(cache_creation_input_tokens) as "cache write", sum(input_tokens) as "fresh input" from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, sum(cache_read_input_tokens) as "cache read", sum(cache_creation_input_tokens) as "cache write", sum(input_tokens) as "fresh input" from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Saved by the cache (API-equivalent)

targets.queryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, sum(m.cache_read_input_tokens * (p.input - p.cache_read)) / 1e6 as saved from messages m join prices p on p.rowid = (select rowid from prices where m.model like family || '%' and since <= date(m.ts,'unixepoch') order by length(family) desc, since desc limit 1) where m.ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, sum(m.cache_read_input_tokens * (p.input - p.cache_read)) / 1e6 as saved from messages m join prices p on p.rowid = (select rowid from prices where m.model like family || '%' and since <= date(m.ts,'unixepoch') order by length(family) desc, since desc limit 1) where m.ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: What the cache-read tokens would have cost at the plain input price, minus what they cost. Not a bill: an estimate at pay-as-you-go API prices; the subscription is a flat fee.
